verdict.rationale: Better Auth publishes a vendor-maintained Auth0 migration guide with a migration script. It covers email/password "with proper hashing," social accounts, 2FA and best-effort Organizations/roles, and a configurable password hashing function supports carrying existing hashes over. missing for 10: an explicit statement that migrated users keep their passwords without a reset, guides for competitors beyond Auth0, and independent hands-on corroboration of the Auth0 migration path.
